name: A Flash Marriage With The Billionaire Tycoon
original_name: A Flash Marriage With The Billionaire Tycoon
overview: Elise was a normal accountant of Hawthorn Group. She worked very carefully to avoid any problem, but she made a huge mistake despite of her caution. She was on a business trip and was drunk, then she accidentally had an one-night stand with her boss Lucian. Her fate had changed since then...
